12R.validation: independent JS reproduction of scripts/audit_recent_history.py rules

schema_changes.margin: A run may provide numeric beaten_margin_s or official beaten_margin_text; at least one is required.

caveats: The original frozen pre-race files are intentionally unchanged.
Career-start counts for a small number of horses were derived from current totals by removing the target race and are annotated in the derived file.
This migration makes inputs structurally eligible; it does not validate predictive accuracy.
